summary: The serial suite passes 16 of 20 tests. Four implementation defects remain. This is round 3, and metadata.json has no escalation key for a third remediation round.
blocking_findings: F5 [Blocker] adversarial-testing: weekOutDir checks lexical containment only. When public/l2/w02 is a symlink to a sibling directory, prepareWithManifest removes that directory's forge/keep.bin and writes the generated spec and audio through the link. Resolve and validate physical paths before any delete, rename, or write; ADV-P1-4g reproduces this in a temporary sandbox.

F6 [Blocker] adversarial-testing: readManifestRows accepts a manifest file symlink whose target is outside the handoff root, and copyManifestSubset imports those external bytes into public output. Reject symlinks or require each resolved source path to remain inside the handoff root; ADV-P1-4h verifies the external bytes appear in the copied Forge file.

F7 [Blocker] adversarial-testing: prepareWithManifest removes the existing Forge directory before the staging rename. When rename fails, the catch removes staging but cannot restore the prior Forge set. Swap without deleting the last good set first, or restore it on failure; ADV-P1-4m simulates failure at the rename call and finds the prior binary missing.
nonblocking_findings: F8 [Major] adversarial-testing: readManifestRows accepts a backslash-separated manifest path, but manifestToForgeInput does not recognize it as a cut-out path and silently omits the character from the cast. Reject or normalize backslashes consistently before validation and adapter mapping; ADV-P1-4k observes cast.pat is undefined.

N1 [Nit] adversarial-testing: a staging folder left by an interrupted process remains under public/l2 after a later successful refresh. The stale folder does not block a new unique stage, but it is not cleaned up; ADV-P1-4i records the behavior.
evidence: F1 withdrawn: ADV-P1-4b compares binary Forge, spec, and audio fixtures before and after a bad-digest refresh; all three remain byte-identical.
F4 withdrawn: ADV-P1-4f rejects the traversal week id and confirms its sibling keep.txt file survives.
The full serial suite reports 16 pass and 4 fail. Failures: ADV-P1-4g, ADV-P1-4h, ADV-P1-4m, and ADV-P1-4k. All other 16 tests pass.

New tests: ADV-P1-4g fails after the output symlink deletes the external sentinel; ADV-P1-4h fails because external handoff bytes are copied; ADV-P1-4i passes and confirms the stale stage remains; ADV-P1-4m fails because a simulated rename failure deletes prior Forge output; ADV-P1-4j passes for Unicode and trailing-newline week ids; ADV-P1-4k fails for backslash paths while the ./ variant is rejected; ADV-P1-4l passes with concurrent child-process refreshes.
ADV-P1-4b and ADV-P1-4f pass, so Green r7 fixes the earlier bad-digest preservation and traversal week-id cases. ADV-P1-4a also rejects a wrong uppercase SHA-256 digest.
Every destructive probe uses a mkdtemp sandbox under the system temporary directory and removes that sandbox. No real public week folder was modified.
